mechanism: Adalimumab (TNF-alpha inhibitor) increases infection risk and may impair immune response to antimalarial therapy; primaquine carries hemolytic risk in G6PD deficiency which may be exacerbated by immunosuppression.
action: Ensure G6PD screening before primaquine use in patients on adalimumab; monitor for hemolytic anemia and infection; consider antimalarial alternatives if possible; maintain close clinical surveillance.
